questions.prompt: Are you wrapping existing code or starting brand new?
questions.why: This reframes the stack/deploy questions below — existing projects get detect-and-confirm prompts, new projects get pick-for-greenfield prompts — and gates whether mission-analyst starts from code analysis or an empty backlog.

questions.prompt: What is the project's name?
One-sentence description of what this project does?
GitHub org/user that owns the repo?
What domain does this project operate in? (e.g. fintech, devtools, consumer app)
Who are the primary users of this project?
Primary programming language?
questions.prompt_new: What language do you want to build this in?
questions.why: For an existing repo we'll try to detect this and just confirm it; for a brand-new project you're picking the language coldstart scaffolds.

questions.prompt: Primary framework/runtime (e.g. FastAPI, Next.js, Express)?
questions.prompt_new: What framework/runtime do you want to scaffold with (e.g. FastAPI, Next.js, Express), or none?
questions.why: Existing projects: confirm what's already there. New projects: pick what to scaffold.

questions.prompt: Package manager?
questions.prompt_new: Which package manager do you want to use?
questions.why: Drives which preflight/build commands the team runs — detected-and-confirmed on existing repos, chosen fresh on new ones.

questions.prompt: Test framework/command?
questions.prompt_new: What test framework do you want to start with?
questions.why: The executor role runs this before every PR — existing repos confirm what's already wired up, new repos pick a starting default.

questions.prompt: Does this project have a user-facing frontend?
questions.why: Determines whether browser-tester/visual-verifier roles are relevant to this project at all.

questions.prompt: Primary deploy target?
questions.prompt_new: Where do you plan to deploy this once it exists?
questions.why: Existing projects: confirm the current deploy target. New projects: pick one so release-manager knows what a release means here.

questions.prompt: CI provider?
questions.prompt_new: Which CI provider do you want to set up?
questions.why: Determines what CI config coldstart should expect or scaffold — detect-and-confirm on existing, pick-for-greenfield on new.

questions.prompt: Is there a staging environment separate from production?
questions.why: Affects merge-gate strictness — a new project usually starts with 'no' until staging exists.

questions.prompt: How often do you expect to ship releases?
questions.why: Tunes how aggressively release-manager batches merges into releases.

questions.prompt: Specific hosting provider (if any beyond the deploy target)?
questions.why: Optional detail beyond deploy_target — only useful if you already know it.

questions.prompt: Production domain (if known yet)?
questions.why: Optional — most projects don't have this decided at coldstart time.

questions.prompt: Autonomy level for spawning sub-agents (1=manual approval each time, 5=fully autonomous)?
Autonomy level for fast-path merges of small/low-risk PRs (1-5)?
Autonomy level for touching external systems (APIs, deploys, third-party services) (1-5)?
Autonomy level for self-generated work/idea intake (1-5)?
Require human approval before every merge?
Require a security review gate on every PR?
What are you building, and what does it do for the people who use it?
Why build this now? What's the motivating problem or opportunity?
What guiding principles or decision-making rules should this project follow?
